description.value: Founded in 2011 by two friends, Timbertrain Coffee Roasters has grown into a well-regarded Vancouver specialty roaster with three café locations, including this Gastown outpost on West Cordova Street. The café emphasizes single-origin and seasonal coffees sourced through direct, transparent relationships with farms across multiple origins. Situated in one of Vancouver's most cycling-accessible and tourist-frequented neighbourhoods, it offers a welcoming community space for a post-ride espresso or bag of freshly roasted beans.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 56m; stands (5 spaces) at 92m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Timbertrain Coffee Roasters is an active specialty coffee roaster and café with three BC locations; the Gastown location at 311 West Cordova matches the OSM record. The contact page corroborates the phone number (236-513-4377). No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, and OSM tags carry no bike infrastructure tags, so all required criteria and most optional amenities remain null.
concerns: Website mentions three brick-and-mortar locations (Gastown, Grandview-Woodlands, Port Moody) — other locations may have separate OSM nodes that could produce duplicate directory entries.
OSM address lacks a postal code; full civic address not corroborated by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is clearly active and well-suited as a cyclist café stop in Gastown, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. On-site verification is needed before listing.
